name: client-facts-mcp
description: Builds one knowledge server per company that holds everything known about its marketing (approved messaging, a daily copy of its website, a facts file with settled, approved, held and never-say rows, house rules, the places it lives online, buyer questions, call notes) and sets one writer loop: get_brief, draft, check_draft, add_asset, with corrections returned through add_note. Use when asked to "set up a facts server for a company", "stop writers using facts from memory", "build a facts file", or make agents write from one source of truth.
